title: [17/12/2023]- A building with fire exits
prompt: The diagram shows the layout of part of a building, indicating the position of the fire exits. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The provided floor plan illustrates the layout of a section of a building, specifically detailing the evacuation routes from seven bedrooms to two separate fire exits.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the floor plan is clearly organized around a long central corridor, with two emergency exits positioned at opposite ends. Consequently, the seven bedrooms are divided into two main groups, each served by the nearest fire exit. Each of these exits is equipped with a staircase and leads to a specific external meeting point.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the left-hand side of the diagram, Fire Exit A is the designated escape route for occupants in Bedrooms 1, 2, and 3. To evacuate, residents from these rooms must proceed into the main corridor and turn left. This exit is located next to a staircase which leads down to Meeting Point 1. Among these three rooms, Bedroom 1 is situated directly opposite the stairs, while Bedroom 3 is also in very close proximity to the exit.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: On the right side of the building, Fire Exit B serves a larger group, encompassing Bedrooms 4, 5, 6, and 7. The evacuation path for these rooms involves moving right along the corridor to a second set of stairs, which provides access to Meeting Point 2. A notable difference in this area is the placement of Bedrooms 5 and 6, which are set back from the main corridor in a small recess. Additionally, a lift is situated centrally in the hallway, positioned closer to the right-hand exit.
